title: MLBSCORINGCHANGE — MLB Live PBP Copy + Scoring-Change Model
description: Working copy of the MLB Live PBP replay-feed site with a scoring-change model on top, built so the original MLB-Live-PBP site is never modified. It scores every play ruled "reached on error" 0–100 for the chance the official ruling becomes a hit (🎯 Error Watch), shows each Scoring Change's pre-change chance and final result, keeps single→error reversals in their own 📉 Hit→Error tab out of the primary alert system, and calibrates ruling-pending distributions from captured outcomes. The 3-hourly official-data pipeline parses MLB's official log, links 693 official entries (229 + 211 + 253) across 7,323 completed games, and reports the current results — 3,161 settled error→hit plays changed 189 times (6.0%), cross-validated AUC 0.609 — while re-testing official-scorer and home-park effects every run (both "not used"). A live capture records error calls with their error type before StatsAPI rewrites them. Honest about limits: error-type adjustment and pending calibration switch on only once enough captured plays settle.
